validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript">
  <script>for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { }</script>
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: `<` starts a tag here, but no element name follows it

notes: in character data `<` always starts markup; a comparison operator must be escaped or placed in a CDATA section
diagnostics.help: escape the operator as `<` (and `&` as `&`), or wrap the whole script body in `<![CDATA[ ... ]]>` so it needs no escaping
spec_references: XML 1.0 (Fifth Edition) §2.4 Character Data and Markup
